content: {"episode_id": "ep-05161", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "PR-204", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (diagnosis I47.1).
